fact_check.claim: Anabel's is a student-run grocery in Anabel Taylor Hall, operating during the academic year
fact_check.note: Page says student-run store in Anabel Taylor Hall, open during the academic year.

fact_check.claim: Anabel's: Room 127, 548 College Ave, Wed-Fri noon-7 p.m., Sat noon-3 p.m., seasonal closures
fact_check.note: Hours and address match; fall break and end-of-semester closures are mentioned.

fact_check.claim: Anabel's accepts SNAP/EBT
fact_check.note: Page says it accepts SNAP/EBT.

fact_check.claim: Anabel's describes its produce as priced at or below Wegmans (2022 Sun)
fact_check.note: Sun says locally sourced produce is priced 'at or below Wegmans prices' per the store's website. It is Anabel's own claim; the article attributes it that way.

fact_check.claim: Cornell Health note dated November 10, 2025: Anabel's offering 50 percent discount to all customers during the government shutdown
fact_check.note: Page has a November 10, 2025 update citing the shutdown and a 50% discount to all customers. Dated and possibly stale; the article already warns against planning around it.

fact_check.claim: Anabel's site describes a 50 percent discount as a one-day promotion
fact_check.note: One-day Spring Break promotion on select items.

fact_check.claim: Wegmans at 500 South Meadow Street, open daily 6 a.m. to midnight
fact_check.note: Address and hours match.

fact_check.claim: Kyle Roth, 'a Cornell Dining student writer', sophomore in Human Ecology
fact_check.note: Page gives Roth as a Human Ecology sophomore, but the byline is 'Dining Department' and he is not described as a Cornell Dining student writer.

fact_check.claim: Route 32 to East Seneca Street stop on the Commons, transfer to Route 15, get off at Wegmans
fact_check.note: Route 32 changes to 15 at that Commons stop; Route 15 goes to the Wegmans stop (then Walmart four stops later).

fact_check.claim: Return Route 15 usually arrives about an hour later
fact_check.note: Page says the return bus 'usually arrives one hour later'.

fact_check.claim: Route 15 runs once an hour on weekdays and takes about half an hour to Wegmans
fact_check.note: Sun (2022): hourly on weekdays only, fastest trip about half an hour. Dated; the article tells readers to check TCAT. NOTE: 'weekdays only' conflicts with the article's advice to shop on a weekend (see fixes).

fact_check.claim: Alexandra Michael '23 and a roommate went three weeks without grocery shopping
fact_check.note: Supported; reason given is no car. Whether 'TCAT felt unpredictable' was her stated reason was not separately confirmed.

fact_check.claim: New students ride TCAT free for their first year with a Cornell ID
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: After the first year, students ride free after 6 p.m. on weekdays and all day weekends; discounted passes otherwise
fact_check.note: Free after 6 p.m. weekdays and Saturday/Sunday; discounted passes at myparking.cornell.edu.

fact_check.claim: Normal TCAT fare is $1.50
fact_check.note: Page says 'normally $1.50'. A postdoc page, flagged by the article as needing confirmation; acceptable but TCAT's own fare page would be better.

fact_check.claim: Wegmans, GreenStar, Tops and Aldi are along Route 13/Meadow Street
fact_check.note: Page lists these stores along Route 13/Meadow Street.

fact_check.claim: Aldi 'on Meadow Street' / 'Meadow Street area' (meta description and table)
fact_check.note: Source says Route 13/Meadow Street corridor generally. A search listing puts Aldi at 505 Third Street, so 'on Meadow Street' is not confirmed. Use the source's wording or give a verified address.

fact_check.claim: Two Aldi stores and one Tops in Ithaca (2022 Sun)
fact_check.note: Matches; 2022 and dated.

fact_check.claim: Tops is the nearest grocery by bus, served by Route 30, service cut by staffing problems in 2022
fact_check.note: Matches (staffing shortages and supply chain issues).

fact_check.claim: Many students without cars rely on a friend with a car
fact_check.note: Sun says students depend on a friend's time even when a friend has a car; paraphrase is acceptable.

fact_check.claim: GreenStar: 307 College Avenue (daily 8 a.m.-11 p.m.), 770 Cascadilla Street, 215 N. Cayuga Street
fact_check.note: Addresses and Collegetown hours match.

fact_check.claim: Katie Go '22, worked at Anabel's: only supermarkets in Collegetown were GreenStar or 7-Eleven, costing more than Wegmans or Walmart
fact_check.note: Matches. Student opinion on price, attributed and dated.

fact_check.claim: GreenStar Double Up Food Bucks doubles what SNAP users can spend on produce and now covers all Ithaca locations (Sun, 2024)
fact_check.note: August 2024 article says it was coming to every Ithaca branch and doubles produce money; it does not confirm current status, and a program benefit rests on a newspaper. 'Now' is not supported. Check greenstar.coop or the Double Up program page.

fact_check.claim: Cornell Food Pantry, 109 McGraw Place, free, confidential, food and personal care items for undergrad, grad, staff and faculty
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Free Food Fridge in Anabel Taylor Hall room 120 with leftovers from Cornell events
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Swipe Out Hunger gives donated dining hall meal swipes
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Cornell Health nutritionists, 607-255-5155
fact_check.note: Phone matches.

fact_check.claim: Cayuga Health Community Cupboard and Human Services Coalition pantry list
fact_check.note: Both on the page. The Cupboard offers free food Mon-Fri at the Cayuga Health entrance at the Ithaca Mall; the article omits these details.

fact_check.claim: Cornell Health suggests trying different stores, store brands and rewards programs
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: BestPlaces.net: Ithaca grocery prices 0.8% above NY average and 4.6% above national average (2022)
fact_check.note: Sun cites these figures from BestPlaces.net; secondhand and dated, but properly labelled.

beats_top.why: The #1 result is a 2022 news feature with no decision guidance. Ours opens with an answer by situation, gives hours, addresses, bus steps and free-food options. But it leaves out stores a student would expect and one piece of its bus advice contradicts its own source.
changes: Cover the stores the planned angle and search results point to that are missing: Price Chopper (P&C Fresh, East Hill Plaza) and Trader Joe's, each with a verified address and hours from an official store page, or say plainly in one line that they were not checked.

Add the Anabel's savings evidence from the NYC Food Policy Center evaluation (https://www.nycfoodpolicy.org/food-policy-snapshot-anabels-grocery-cornell-university/): verify it first, then use its fall 2021 figure with the date in place of relying only on Anabel's self-description.
Fix the weekend-bus advice so the 'cheap' plan is actually usable, and link TCAT's own Route 15 timetable.

fixes: In the 'Our advice' paragraph under Fares, delete 'go on a weekend when the ride is free' or replace it. The Sun (https://cornellsun.com/2022/11/30/lack-of-nearby-grocery-stores-leave-students-with-limited-options/) says Route 15 runs weekdays only. Instead say: free rides apply after 6 p.m. on weekdays and on weekends (https://sustainable.cornell.edu/focus-areas/transportation/bus-commuting), but confirm on TCAT's timetable that Route 15 runs on the day and time you plan to go.

Change 'A Cornell Dining student writer, Kyle Roth, a sophomore in Human Ecology' to 'Kyle Roth, a Human Ecology sophomore writing for the Sun's Dining Department column' or simply 'a Sun dining writer'; the source does not call him a Cornell Dining student writer. Source: https://cornellsun.com/2023/05/03/culinary-autonomy-cooking-for-yourself

Remove 'on Meadow Street' for Aldi from the meta description, the table row ('Wegmans or Aldi, Meadow Street area') and the intro. Use 'along Route 13/Meadow Street' for Wegmans, Tops and Aldi as the postdoc page says (https://postdocs.cornell.edu/postdoc-life/essentials-in-ithaca/), or give an Aldi address and hours from https://www.aldi.us store locator after opening it. Keep the 'could not confirm a bus line to Aldi' caveat.

In the GreenStar section, replace 'now covers all its Ithaca locations' with 'the Sun reported in August 2024 that it was being brought to every Ithaca GreenStar branch; ask at the register that it is still running'. Add a link to GreenStar's own page on Double Up Food Bucks if one can be opened, and treat the program benefit as unconfirmed otherwise. Source: https://www.cornellsun.com/article/2024/08/savings-forecasted-to-bloom-with-double-up-food-bucks-at-all-greenstar-locations

Add a short section for Price Chopper (P&C Fresh) in East Hill Plaza and Trader Joe's (744 S. Meadow St.): for each, take address and hours from the store's own site and say whether a TCAT route serves it (from TCAT's site, or say it is not confirmed). Do not state prices. If an official page cannot be opened, state in one sentence that you did not check them.

Add the Cayuga Health Community Cupboard detail from the Cornell Health page: free local farm-fresh food Monday to Friday at the Cayuga Health entrance at the Ithaca Mall (https://health.cornell.edu/services/nutrition-services/affordable-food). Replace the vague last bullet with this.
Add a link to TCAT's current Route 15 timetable (https://tcatbus.com) in the Wegmans-by-bus section and, if possible, replace the postdoc page as the fare source with TCAT's fare page.
